Every decision is an unfolding,
All unfolding is without choice.
God wills everything that ever could be
But makes no decision one way or another -
That he leaves to the sentient.
The Mayflower asks, however,
"What to God is "the sentient?"
The Day replies,
"A god's-eye-view."
True, but that's decided by who?
